name: abc-creations
description: Deploy shim so Railway/Nixpacks can build the Nest API from the monorepo root. The Vercel frontend uses frontend/ as its Root Directory and ignores this file.

scripts.build: npm ci --prefix backend && npm run prisma:generate --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.start: npm run prisma:migrate:deploy --prefix backend && npm run start:prod --prefix backend
